name: Zozo Portfolio for Elementor
author: zozothemes

sections.description:
Zozo Portfolio for Elementor is a powerful and modern portfolio plugin built for creative professionals, agencies, designers, developers, and photographers.
It provides advanced Elementor widgets, AJAX filtering, beautiful layouts, and complete customization options.

Features

Portfolio Management

  • Custom Post Type for Portfolios
  • Portfolio Categories and Tags
  • Category Image Support
  • Custom Meta Fields

Elementor Widgets

  • Portfolio Grid
  • Portfolio Masonry
  • Portfolio Slider
  • Portfolio List
  • Portfolio List Slider
  • Portfolio Accordion
  • Portfolio Filter
  • Portfolio Category Display

Advanced Features

  • Filterable Galleries
  • Image 360° Viewer
  • Before/After Image Comparison
  • Custom Portfolio Templates
  • Archive Page Templates
  • AJAX Loading Support
  • Infinite Scroll
  • Lightbox Integration
  • Responsive Design

Customization Options

  • Custom Skin Colors
  • Multiple Icon Libraries (Font Awesome, Themify, Bootstrap Icons)
  • Custom Spacing Controls
  • Drag & Drop Interface
  • Customizable Templates

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • Elementor Page Builder
  • PHP 7.0 or higher

External Services

This plugin uses third-party libraries (Swiper, Isotope, Pannellum, etc.) and optional demo content import from:
https://demo.zozothemes.com/import/zozo-portfolio/*.xml

No personal data is transmitted.

Support

For support and bug reports, visit:
https://zozothemes.com/

License

GPL v2 or later – https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the zozo-portfolio folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated
  4. Start creating portfolios using the new “Portfolio” menu item in your WordPress dashboard
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, Elementor is required because all portfolio widgets depend on Elementor’s page builder interface.

Can I customize portfolio templates?

Yes. You can override templates by placing custom files inside:
your-theme/zozo-portfolio/

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, the plugin is fully theme-independent and works with any modern WordPress theme.

Is AJAX filtering supported?

Yes, the plugin includes AJAX filtering, load more, and infinite scroll.

Are external libraries included?

Yes, libraries such as Swiper, Isotope, Pannellum, and Magnific Popup are included under their respective licenses.
